stocks.title: Oil is the weekend risk: Brent topped 108 Friday, its highest since May
stocks.detail: Iran put forces on high alert, a supertanker blew up on a mine in Hormuz and Houthis hit Saudi targets. Crude is already feeding the 3.7% CPI print. Any further spike before Sunday's futures open is bad news for QQQ and rate-cut hopes.

stocks.title: VIX jumped about 21% to 19.99 Friday as Fear and Greed hit extreme fear
stocks.detail: The S&P fell 1.09% and the Nasdaq more than 2% on options-expiration Friday, with a late VIX spike and hedge-fund-stress rumors. Some traders treat extreme fear as a contrarian buy signal; others expect more swings next week.

stocks.title: Bitcoin holds near 81.5K even as spot ETFs bleed for the week
stocks.detail: US spot bitcoin ETFs saw about 82 million in net outflows Friday and about 228 million for the week, led by BlackRock's IBIT, yet BTC is holding the 81K to 82K support. A break either way this weekend is the first risk tell for Monday.

stocks.title: Schwab launches bitcoin and ether trading for its retail clients
stocks.detail: Schwab Crypto is now live for eligible US clients at a flat 0.75% per trade through Paxos, with Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink planned by year-end. Another big step for mainstream crypto access, and competition for HOOD and COIN.

tech.title: Tesla's new Roadster flips, drives upside down and hops cars with thrusters
tech.detail: At a SpaceX site in Texas, the second-gen Roadster showed cold-gas thrusters for jumps and a claimed 0 to 60 in 0.81 seconds. Production is targeted for 2028; road legality of the flying tricks is unclear. Big hype fuel for TSLA.

tech.title: Musk: Optimus will build Optimus Prime
tech.detail: Musk's playful Friday post went viral. Posts say Optimus is being built in the hundreds per week at Fremont with a goal of over 1,000 by year-end. Robotics is a core piece of the TSLA bull case, so every update moves the narrative.

tech.title: Anthropic reportedly posts 16.8B in Q3 revenue and turns profitable
tech.detail: Posts on X say revenue grew 45% from the prior quarter with adjusted profitability and positive free cash flow, as IPO talk swirls around a possible 1.5 trillion valuation. A contrast to the AI-capex stress hitting semis this week.

tech.title: Linus Torvalds vibe-coded a Python tool with Google's Antigravity
tech.detail: The Linux creator merged an AI-generated audio visualizer into his AudioNoise hobby project, kept the core C code hand-written, and said the result beat what he would have done by hand. Devs are split on what it means for real skills.

world.title: Houthi strikes hit Riyadh's main airport as Saudi Arabia vows a response
world.detail: Attacks on King Khalid International Airport killed at least a dozen and disrupted flights, and an Aramco building in Dhahran caught fire earlier. Saudi officials promise serious self-defense. Escalation in the Gulf is the top oil risk.

world.title: Iran warns ships in Hormuz after a supertanker hits a mine
world.detail: Iran's Revolutionary Guard released footage of a loaded supertanker burning after hitting a mine and warned other vessels. US Central Command insists the strait remains open, with hundreds of merchant ships passing safely last week.

world.title: Chiefs host the Chargers Sunday at 3:25 PM ET without Rashee Rice
world.detail: Andy Reid ruled out Rice (hamstring) and left tackle Josh Simmons (back), with L'Jarius Sneed questionable. The Chargers ruled out five, including Derwin James and Joe Alt. More targets could go to Kelce and Xavier Worthy.

world.title: Lakers close the preseason with a 121-106 loss to Denver
world.detail: LA tried an experimental lineup with Doncic, Reaves, Thybulle, Ziaire Williams and Walker Kessler. Reaves led with 19 and Doncic had 15, and Cam Johnson was ejected for a flagrant on Reaves. The regular season tips off Tuesday.

gbot.name: GROK
gbot.say: Brent over 108 and Hormuz on edge, so Sunday's 6 PM futures open matters. Chiefs-Chargers at 3:25 first, Kent.
